# Amsonia

Amsonia is a technical product family published by Willuny Labs. Amsonia Core is its open-source foundation for tenant-safe delegated authorization in Go.

- Product home: https://amsonia.dev/
- Amsonia Core: https://amsonia.dev/core
- Documentation: https://amsonia.dev/docs
- Getting started: https://amsonia.dev/core/docs/getting-started
- API contract: https://amsonia.dev/core/api
- Security model: https://amsonia.dev/core/security
- Releases: https://amsonia.dev/releases
- Source: https://github.com/willunylabs/amsonia-core
- Commercial distribution: https://willuny.xyz/amsonia

This file is a convenience index for developer tools. Canonical HTML pages and sitemap.xml remain the authoritative public sources.
